findings.title: Lithuanian totpStep1 replaced with Italian text
findings.body: The new value of totpStep1 in the Lithuanian (lt) account bundle is "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:" which is Italian (it matches the messages_it.properties translation), not Lithuanian. The previous value was a proper Lithuanian translation containing <a> links; while removing the links was needed for the sanitizer, the replacement text was apparently copied from the wrong language file. Lithuanian users setting up an authenticator app will now be shown Italian instructions. It should be a Lithuanian rendering of "Install one of the following applications on your mobile:".

findings.title: Lithuanian loginTotpStep1 replaced with Italian text
findings.body: The new value of loginTotpStep1 in the Lithuanian (lt) login bundle is "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:" which is Italian, not Lithuanian (it matches the Italian translation, likely copied from messages_it.properties). The surrounding entries (loginTotpStep2, loginTotpStep3) are Lithuanian, so users on the OTP setup page will see one step in Italian. It should be a Lithuanian rendering of "Install one of the following applications on your mobile:".

findings.title: zh_CN (Simplified Chinese) bundle now contains Traditional Chinese text
findings.body: The new value of totpStep1 in the zh_CN account bundle is "在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：", which uses Traditional Chinese characters (手機/安裝/應用程式) as used in the zh_TW bundle, while the rest of this file and zh_CN users expect Simplified Chinese (手机/安装/应用). It looks like the line was copied from messages_zh_TW.properties. Simplified Chinese users will see mixed-script text on the authenticator setup page; the line should be rewritten in Simplified Chinese.

findings.title: JS console bundles switched from i18next {{0}} to Java MessageFormat {0}/{2,choice,...} syntax
findings.body: The keycloak.v3 account console and keycloak.v2 admin console localize server error keys in the browser with i18next, whose interpolation syntax is {{0}} — every sibling error key in this file uses it (e.g. error-username-invalid-character='{{0}}' contains invalid character., error-empty=Please specify value of '{{0}}'). This change switches error-invalid-multivalued-size to Java MessageFormat syntax ({0}/{1}/{2} plus a {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values} pattern) which i18next cannot evaluate. When multivalued-attribute size validation fails, these consoles will render the raw text "Attribute {0} must have at least {1} and at most {2} {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}." to end users instead of a formatted message. The identical change was made in js/apps/admin-ui/maven-resources/theme/keycloak.v2/admin/messages/messages_en.properties and has the same problem. The Java MessageFormat wording is correct for the server-rendered bundles (themes/src/main/resources/...), but the JS bundles should keep the previous {{0}} … value(s). wording, which the new verifier also accepts.

findings.title: Diff-snippet computation can throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException instead of reporting the violation
findings.body: In the "Illegal HTML" reporting branch, start (common prefix length) and end (common suffix length) are computed independently, so they can overlap: when the sanitizer output contains the entire input as a prefix and also shares its tail (e.g. input value "" that the sanitizer normalizes to "" yields start=3 and end=2), then value.substring(start, value.length() - end) is invoked with begin (3) > end (1) and throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException. Instead of the intended "Illegal HTML in key …" message, the verification aborts with an unhandled exception and a bare stack trace, and no further keys/files are checked. Clamp the values so start + end never exceeds the string length for both strings, e.g. end = Math.min(end, value.length() - start) and end = Math.min(end, sanitized.length() - start).
